requirements.text: The system shall generate unique voucher numbers using a format of Project Code, Group Batch, Batch Number, Voucher Number, and a Security Code.
The system shall support printing voucher details as bar-codes for tracking purposes.
The system shall allow authorized users to amend the validity date of vouchers.
The system shall maintain master records for distributors, including contact details, business type, and location.
The system shall record distribution transactions, linking vouchers to specific distributors and sales personnel.
The system shall capture claim details including patient information, diagnosis, lab tests, and prescribed drugs.
The system shall automatically calculate claim amounts based on pre-defined VSP payment terms and drug prices.
The system shall validate claims and move incomplete or fraudulent claims to a quarantine area.
The system shall support the entry of client feedback linked to specific voucher numbers.
The system shall generate standard and customized reports, including financial, medical, and statistical summaries.
The system shall implement role-based access control where permissions are assigned to user groups at the screen and action level.
The system shall interface with biometric thumb-print readers to verify patient identity on claim forms.
The system shall automatically deactivate a VSP if more than two fraud entries are detected.
The database shall use sequential links with surrogate keys to ensure efficient storage and prevent unused space.
The user interface shall utilize drop-down selection menus for all transaction screens to minimize manual data entry and errors.
The system shall be developed on the Oracle 9i platform with a Visual Basic front-end and Crystal Reports 9 for reporting.
